author: Bridget
body: As a first-time parent, I felt overwhelmed by the numerous options for every item on the registry, but Katie completely put me at ease. She created a detailed report showing which items to swap, which to remove to save money, and new items to add that I hadn’t even considered. The service basically paid for itself! Her knowledge of baby items is invaluable, and her service made me feel so much more confident in my choices.
